in_marathi.name: Goodu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Goodu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goodu is a Hindu name that is derived from the Sanskrit and Telugu languages. It is a unisex name that has themes of goodness, nature, and blessing. The name Goodu means 'good' and 'blessed'. It is a simple and beautiful name that is perfect for parents who want to give their child a name that reflects their love and hope for their child's future.
